title: Detect missing workload ownership and cost-allocation metadata

problem.business_outcome: Route cost and governance findings to an accountable synthetic workload owner.
problem.risk_statement: Resources without stable ownership and allocation metadata can create delayed remediation, unallocated spend, and weak accountability.
problem.baseline: Unknown until the local fixture and optional sandbox read-only query are evaluated.

excluded: Resource types that do not support the selected metadata

control.objective: Identify applicable resources missing an approved workload owner, environment, or cost-center value without changing the resource.
control.mechanism: Azure Resource Graph query for a future Reader-only sandbox assessment

sources.reference: Synthetic fixture planned for roadmap phase 1

tests.name: All required synthetic tags present
tests.expected: The resource is absent from the missing-metadata result.

tests.name: One required synthetic tag missing
tests.expected: The resource appears once with the missing field identified.

tests.name: Unsupported resource type
tests.expected: The resource is classified as not applicable rather than compliant.

tests.name: Inaccessible scope
tests.expected: Coverage is unknown and no compliance conclusion is produced.

evidence.freshness_expectation: Timestamp every run and state that Resource Graph can have indexing latency.
evidence.retention: Keep only synthetic fixture output in the public repository.
limitations: Tag presence does not prove tag accuracy or financial allocation.
Not every resource or charge supports the same tags.
The query has not yet been run against an Azure sandbox.

rollout.scale_gate: The fixture tests pass and a Reader-only sandbox run reports scope, pagination, failures, and unknowns correctly.
rollout.rollback_trigger: The collector performs any write, exposes real identifiers, or misclassifies inaccessible scope as compliant.
rollout.stop_rule: Stop before any policy assignment; a separate contract and authorization are required for Azure writes.

costs.description: Time to build and validate the synthetic query and fixture.
costs.evidence: Time tracking is not yet implemented.

benefits.description: Potential improvement in finding routing and allocation visibility.
benefits.evidence: No sandbox observation or financial validation exists.

economics.delivery_friction_metric: Minutes required for a workload owner to understand and resolve one finding

triggers: Azure Resource Graph query behavior changes
The first synthetic fixture is added

assumptions: The proposed metadata fields are useful to a representative platform and finance team.
The query can be executed with Reader at the intended sandbox scope.
known_limits: No synthetic estate fixture exists yet.
No Azure tenant behavior has been observed.
The example does not authorize a policy assignment or resource modification.
